title: Forecast Forge — Forecasting + Decision Model
summary: A forecasting and scenario model that makes assumptions explicit and supports planning decisions under uncertainty.
problem: Planning decisions (inventory, staffing, timelines) were being made with inconsistent assumptions and no shared view of risk. Teams needed a model that was transparent, easy to adjust, and grounded in real drivers.
approach: Identified the key demand drivers, built a baseline forecast, then layered scenarios (best/base/worst) with documented assumptions. Packaged it as a decision tool (inputs → outputs → sensitivity) so stakeholders could compare tradeoffs quickly.
outcome: Improved planning conversations by making assumptions visible, enabling faster scenario comparisons, and reducing rework caused by misaligned inputs.
